raw_response: {"diagnosis": "60 of 200 raw_customers rows store region as a numeric code ('01'-'04') instead of a region name, and silver_customers passes these codes through unchanged. The raw_region_map table provides the authoritative code-to-name mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), so silver_customers should translate codes through it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(upper(trim(m.region_name)), upper(trim(c.region))) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT region_code, region_name FROM raw_region_map) m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
